entries.question: Tell me about yourself.
aliases: Could you introduce yourself?
Please walk me through your background.
Proszę opowiedzieć coś o sobie.
Czy może Pan krótko się przedstawić?
entries.answer: My name is Oleg Rakhimov. My background combines legal, business, technical and customer-facing experience. I worked as a lawyer, managed businesses in advertising and ventilation installation, and later developed software projects in Poland. Throughout these roles, I communicated with clients, investigated problems, explained solutions and followed work through to completion. I use Polish every day and now want to apply this experience in an international customer support role.
entries.firstSentence: My name is Oleg Rakhimov.

entries.question: Could you walk me through your professional background?
aliases: Describe your work history.
What is your professional experience?
Jak wyglądało Pana doświadczenie zawodowe?
entries.answer: I started as a lawyer in a road construction organisation from 2004 to 2006. I then managed an advertising production business from 2006 to 2008. After several technical and creative roles, I ran a ventilation installation organisation from 2015 to 2021. Since moving to Poland in 2021, I completed a qualification in administration and continued developing software and technical support skills.
entries.firstSentence: I started as a lawyer in a road construction organisation from 2004 to 2006.

entries.question: Why do you want to work in customer support?
aliases: Why are you interested in customer support?
Why do you want to work in customer service?
Why customer support?
Why do you want to go into customer support?
Why do we want to go to customer support?
Why do we want to work in customer support?
Co interesuje Pana w obsłudze klienta?
Dlaczego chce Pan pracować w obsłudze klienta?
entries.answer: I want to work in customer support because I enjoy helping people and solving practical problems. In my legal work and my own businesses, I communicated directly with clients, identified their needs, explained options and followed matters through to completion. My technical work also involves investigating problems, giving clear explanations and documenting the next step. This role would let me use these strengths directly while continuing to develop in an international environment.
entries.firstSentence: I want to work in customer support because I enjoy helping people and solving practical problems.

entries.question: Why do you want to move from software development to customer support?
aliases: Why are you changing careers?
Why leave development for support?
Dlaczego chce Pan przejść z programowania do obsługi klienta?
entries.answer: I do not see it as a complete change of direction. My technical work already includes user feedback, troubleshooting, clear explanations, documentation and follow-up. I have also spent many years communicating with clients through legal work and my own businesses. I realised that I enjoy the communication and problem-solving side of work, and I want to use it in a more customer-focused role.
entries.firstSentence: I do not see it as a complete change of direction.

entries.question: Why are you interested in our company and this vacancy?
aliases: Why do you want to work for us?
What attracted you to this role?
Dlaczego interesuje Pana ta oferta?
entries.answer: This vacancy combines three things that fit my background: daily communication in Polish, practical problem-solving and work in an international environment. I also value the clear responsibilities, remote format and opportunity to learn a professional customer support process. The role would let me use my existing experience while developing further in an international company.
entries.firstSentence: This vacancy combines three things that fit my background: daily communication in Polish, practical problem-solving and work in an international environment.

entries.question: Why would you like to work in the jewellery industry?
aliases: What interests you about jewellery products?
Dlaczego branża jubilerska?
entries.answer: I do not yet have direct jewellery-industry experience, so I would not pretend to be a product expert from the first day. What interests me is learning a detailed product catalogue and helping customers make important personal purchases with accurate information. My experience learning technical products and explaining them clearly would help me build the required product knowledge.
entries.firstSentence: I do not yet have direct jewellery-industry experience, so I would not pretend to be a product expert from the first day.

entries.question: What are your main strengths?
aliases: What would you say are your strengths?
Jakie są Pana mocne strony?
entries.answer: My main strengths are calm communication, practical problem-solving and responsibility for follow-up. I listen carefully, clarify what the customer actually needs and explain the next step in clear language. My legal, business and technical experience also helps me look at a problem from several angles without losing attention to documentation and deadlines.
entries.firstSentence: My main strengths are calm communication, practical problem-solving and responsibility for follow-up.

entries.question: What is one area you are currently improving?
aliases: What is your weakness?
What would you like to improve?
Jaka jest Pana słaba strona?
entries.answer: I am continuing to improve my spoken English. I can communicate at an intermediate level and work with professional information, but I want to become faster and more natural in live conversations. I practise regularly and focus on clear, accurate language rather than complicated expressions.
entries.firstSentence: I am continuing to improve my spoken English.

entries.question: Why should we hire you?
aliases: What makes you suitable for this position?
Why are you the right candidate?
Dlaczego powinniśmy Pana zatrudnić?
entries.answer: You should consider me because I combine strong Polish communication with real client-facing, business and technical experience. I know how to listen, identify a problem, explain a solution, document the case and complete follow-up. I am comfortable with digital tools, ready for rotating shifts and serious about relocating to Serbia and building long-term experience in customer support.
entries.firstSentence: You should consider me because I combine strong Polish communication with real client-facing, business and technical experience.

entries.question: What does excellent customer service mean to you?
aliases: How do you define good customer service?
Co oznacza dla Pana dobra obsługa klienta?
entries.answer: Excellent customer service means listening carefully, giving accurate information and taking responsibility for the next step. The customer should feel heard and understand what will happen, when it will happen and who is responsible. Even when the answer is not what the customer hoped for, communication should remain respectful, clear and honest.
entries.firstSentence: Excellent customer service means listening carefully, giving accurate information and taking responsibility for the next step.

entries.question: How would you handle an angry customer?
aliases: How do you deal with an upset customer?
Tell me how you handle difficult clients.
Jak poradziłby Pan sobie ze zdenerwowanym klientem?
entries.answer: First, I would let the customer explain the problem without interrupting. I would acknowledge the frustration, confirm the important facts and explain what I can do. I would avoid arguing or making promises I cannot guarantee. If another team was needed, I would escalate the case, give a realistic update and make sure the promised follow-up was completed.
entries.firstSentence: First, I would let the customer explain the problem without interrupting.

entries.question: How would you deal with an impatient customer?
aliases: What if a customer keeps demanding an immediate answer?
Jak obsłużyłby Pan niecierpliwego klienta?
entries.answer: I would stay calm and show that I understand the urgency. I would give the customer the information already available, explain what still needs to be checked and provide a realistic time for the next update. Regular, honest communication is usually more helpful than promising an immediate solution that may not be possible.
entries.firstSentence: I would stay calm and show that I understand the urgency.

entries.question: What would you do if a customer complained about a delayed order?
aliases: How would you handle a late delivery?
Co zrobiłby Pan w przypadku opóźnionego zamówienia?
entries.answer: I would verify the customer and order details, check the latest delivery status and explain clearly what information is available. I would not promise a delivery date unless it was confirmed. If the logistics team needed to investigate, I would escalate the case, tell the customer when to expect an update and document the follow-up.
entries.firstSentence: I would verify the customer and order details, check the latest delivery status and explain clearly what information is available.
groundingFacts: No confirmed retail order experience; answer is procedural

entries.question: How would you handle an incorrect order?
aliases: What if the customer received the wrong item?
Klient otrzymał zły produkt — co Pan zrobi?
entries.answer: I would confirm the order number, the item ordered and the item received. Then I would check the company procedure for replacement or return and explain the next steps clearly. I would document the evidence, arrange the appropriate escalation if authorisation was needed and keep the customer informed until the case was resolved.
entries.firstSentence: I would confirm the order number, the item ordered and the item received.

entries.question: What would you do if a product arrived damaged?
aliases: How would you manage a damaged-item complaint?
Co zrobić, gdy produkt jest uszkodzony?
entries.answer: I would apologise for the situation, verify the order and ask for the information required by company procedure, such as a description or photographs. I would explain the replacement or return process, avoid blaming the customer or delivery company and make sure the case was documented and followed through.
entries.firstSentence: I would apologise for the situation, verify the order and ask for the information required by company procedure, such as a description or photographs.

entries.question: How would you help a customer who cannot clearly explain the problem?
aliases: What if the customer is confused?
Jak pomóc klientowi, który nie potrafi dokładnie opisać problemu?
entries.answer: I would ask short, specific questions one at a time and repeat my understanding in simple words. For example, I would confirm what the customer expected, what actually happened and when it happened. This helps reduce confusion and makes the customer feel that I am listening rather than rushing to an assumption.
entries.firstSentence: I would ask short, specific questions one at a time and repeat my understanding in simple words.

entries.question: What would you do if you did not know the answer?
aliases: How do you respond when you are unsure?
Co Pan zrobi, jeśli nie zna odpowiedzi?
entries.answer: I would be honest that I need to check the information instead of guessing. I would use the knowledge base or ask the appropriate colleague, give the customer a realistic time for an update and record the question so the follow-up was not missed. Accuracy is more important than giving a fast but incorrect answer.
entries.firstSentence: I would be honest that I need to check the information instead of guessing.

entries.question: How would you explain a complicated process to a non-technical customer?
aliases: How do you simplify technical information?
Jak wyjaśnia Pan skomplikowane rzeczy klientowi?
entries.answer: I would divide the process into a few clear steps, avoid unnecessary technical terms and check after each important point that the customer understands. I would use an example when helpful and finish by confirming the exact next action. This is something I already do when explaining technical or legal matters in ordinary language.
entries.firstSentence: I would divide the process into a few clear steps, avoid unnecessary technical terms and check after each important point that the customer understands.
groundingFacts: Explains technical and legal matters clearly

entries.question: How do you make sure that a customer feels heard?
aliases: How do you show empathy?
Jak sprawić, aby klient czuł się wysłuchany?
entries.answer: I let the customer finish, summarise the issue in my own words and acknowledge the effect it has had. Then I explain what I can do and what the next step will be. The important point is not only to use polite words, but to show through accurate action and follow-up that the customer’s concern was understood.
entries.firstSentence: I let the customer finish, summarise the issue in my own words and acknowledge the effect it has had.

entries.question: How would you refuse an unreasonable request professionally?
aliases: What if a customer asks for something outside policy?
Jak odmówić klientowi w profesjonalny sposób?
entries.answer: I would acknowledge what the customer wants, explain the relevant policy calmly and avoid blaming language. Then I would offer any available alternative or explain the correct escalation route. I would not promise an exception that I was not authorised to make, but I would still try to leave the customer with a clear next step.
entries.firstSentence: I would acknowledge what the customer wants, explain the relevant policy calmly and avoid blaming language.

entries.question: Tell me about a difficult problem you solved.
aliases: Give me an example of your problem-solving.
Proszę opowiedzieć o trudnym problemie, który Pan rozwiązał.
entries.answer: In my technical work, I often need to investigate an issue that is described only by its symptoms. I first reproduce the problem, separate technical facts from assumptions and check the workflow step by step. Then I implement or coordinate a practical fix, verify the result and explain it clearly to the people affected. This structured approach also applies well to customer cases.
entries.firstSentence: In my technical work, I often need to investigate an issue that is described only by its symptoms.

entries.question: How do you investigate a customer problem?
aliases: What is your troubleshooting process?
Jak analizuje Pan problem klienta?
entries.answer: I first collect the basic facts: who is affected, what was expected, what happened, when it started and what has already been tried. Then I check the available records, reproduce the issue when possible and compare it with the correct process. I document the findings, resolve what I can and escalate with complete information when necessary.
entries.firstSentence: I first collect the basic facts: who is affected, what was expected, what happened, when it started and what has already been tried.

entries.question: How do you decide whether to resolve or escalate an issue?
aliases: When do you escalate a case?
Kiedy przekazuje Pan sprawę dalej?
entries.answer: I resolve the issue myself when it is within my knowledge, authority and company procedure. I escalate when there is financial or legal risk, a system problem, missing authorisation or a specialist decision is required. Before escalating, I collect the relevant facts and explain clearly what has already been checked so the customer does not have to start again.
entries.firstSentence: I resolve the issue myself when it is within my knowledge, authority and company procedure.

entries.question: What information would you collect before escalating a case?
aliases: What should an escalation contain?
Jakie informacje zbiera Pan przed eskalacją?
entries.answer: I would include the customer and order identifiers, a concise description of the issue, the expected and actual result, important dates, actions already taken, available evidence and the exact decision or help required. A clear escalation saves time for the next team and leads to a faster answer for the customer.
entries.firstSentence: I would include the customer and order identifiers, a concise description of the issue, the expected and actual result, important dates, actions already taken, available evidence and the exact decision or help required.

entries.question: What would you do if a customer reported the same problem repeatedly?
aliases: How would you handle a recurring issue?
Co zrobić, gdy problem klienta ciągle wraca?
entries.answer: I would review the full history instead of treating each contact as a separate new case. I would confirm what solutions were already attempted, look for a common cause and escalate with the complete history if the previous solution did not work. I would also keep the customer informed and avoid asking for information already recorded.
entries.firstSentence: I would review the full history instead of treating each contact as a separate new case.

entries.question: What would you do if the customer support system was unavailable?
aliases: How would you work during a system outage?
Co Pan zrobi w razie awarii systemu?
entries.answer: I would follow the company’s outage procedure, inform the responsible team and keep only the minimum temporary notes allowed by policy. I would tell customers honestly that the system is temporarily unavailable without exposing internal details. When service returned, I would enter the records correctly and complete any pending follow-up.
entries.firstSentence: I would follow the company’s outage procedure, inform the responsible team and keep only the minimum temporary notes allowed by policy.

entries.question: How would you answer a question about a product you do not know well?
aliases: What if you do not know the product?
Co Pan zrobi, jeśli nie zna produktu?
entries.answer: I would not guess. I would check the approved product information or consult a knowledgeable colleague, then return with an accurate answer. At the same time, I would note the topic for further study so that I could answer similar questions faster in the future.
entries.firstSentence: I would not guess.

entries.question: How would you learn a large product catalogue?
aliases: How do you build product knowledge?
Jak nauczy się Pan dużego katalogu produktów?
entries.answer: I would first learn the main product categories, the most common customer questions and the important differences between similar products. I would use the knowledge base, create short notes and practise typical scenarios. I would also record unfamiliar questions from real contacts and review them regularly with feedback from experienced colleagues.
entries.firstSentence: I would first learn the main product categories, the most common customer questions and the important differences between similar products.

entries.question: What would you do if an item was out of stock?
aliases: How would you help when a product is unavailable?
Co zrobić, gdy produktu nie ma w magazynie?
entries.answer: I would confirm the current availability and avoid promising a restock date unless it was official. I would explain the available options, such as a similar product, notification when stock returns or cancellation according to policy. The goal would be to give the customer a useful choice without creating false expectations.
entries.firstSentence: I would confirm the current availability and avoid promising a restock date unless it was official.

entries.question: How would you explain a return or exchange policy?
aliases: How do you handle return questions?
Jak wyjaśni Pan zasady zwrotu lub wymiany?
entries.answer: I would first verify the order and then explain the policy in simple steps: eligibility, time limit, required condition of the product, documents or packaging, shipping method and expected processing time. I would check that the customer understood the next action and document the guidance I provided.
entries.firstSentence: I would first verify the order and then explain the policy in simple steps: eligibility, time limit, required condition of the product, documents or packaging, shipping method and expected processing time.
groundingFacts: No confirmed direct retail return processing

entries.question: What would you do if a customer demanded a refund outside the policy?
aliases: How would you manage an exception request?
Klient żąda zwrotu poza regulaminem — co Pan zrobi?
entries.answer: I would listen, verify the facts and explain the policy calmly. I would check whether any authorised exception or alternative solution was available, but I would not promise a refund without authority. If the case required a supervisor’s decision, I would escalate it with complete information and give the customer a realistic update.
entries.firstSentence: I would listen, verify the facts and explain the policy calmly.
groundingFacts: No confirmed direct retail refund experience

entries.question: How would you handle a payment-related complaint?
aliases: What if a payment failed or was charged twice?
Jak obsłuży Pan problem z płatnością?
entries.answer: I would verify the customer and order details without asking for sensitive information that support is not allowed to collect. I would identify whether the issue was a failed payment, duplicate charge or missing refund, check the available records and follow the company’s secure payment procedure. Financial cases should be documented carefully and escalated when authorisation or a payment specialist is required.
entries.firstSentence: I would verify the customer and order details without asking for sensitive information that support is not allowed to collect.

entries.question: How would you protect customer information?
aliases: What does data privacy mean in customer support?
Jak chroniłby Pan dane klienta?
entries.answer: I would verify identity according to company procedure, access only the information needed for the case and never share customer data with an unauthorised person. I would use approved systems, avoid copying sensitive information into unsafe notes and report any suspected data issue immediately.
entries.firstSentence: I would verify identity according to company procedure, access only the information needed for the case and never share customer data with an unauthorised person.

entries.question: Why is accurate documentation important?
aliases: Why should every contact be documented?
Dlaczego dokładna dokumentacja jest ważna?
entries.answer: Accurate documentation gives the next employee the full context, prevents the customer from repeating the story and makes promised follow-up visible. It also helps the company identify recurring problems and verify what was communicated. My technical and administrative work has taught me to keep information clear, factual and complete.
entries.firstSentence: Accurate documentation gives the next employee the full context, prevents the customer from repeating the story and makes promised follow-up visible.

entries.question: What information should be recorded after a customer interaction?
aliases: What would you write in a ticket?
Co powinno znaleźć się w notatce po kontakcie z klientem?
entries.answer: I would record the reason for contact, verified customer or order references, the important facts, actions taken, information given, any promised deadline, escalation details and the next owner of the case. Notes should be concise and factual, without personal opinions or unnecessary sensitive data.
entries.firstSentence: I would record the reason for contact, verified customer or order references, the important facts, actions taken, information given, any promised deadline, escalation details and the next owner of the case.

entries.question: How do you make sure follow-up is completed?
aliases: How do you avoid forgetting customer promises?
Jak pilnuje Pan dalszego kontaktu z klientem?
entries.answer: I record the exact next action, responsible person and expected time in the system. I review open cases regularly and do not close a case until the promised action is completed or clearly transferred. If there is a delay, I update the customer before the promised time rather than waiting for another complaint.
entries.firstSentence: I record the exact next action, responsible person and expected time in the system.

entries.question: Have you worked with CRM or ticketing systems?
aliases: Do you know Zendesk or Salesforce?
What customer-support software have you used?
Czy pracował Pan w CRM lub systemie zgłoszeń?
entries.answer: I have not yet worked extensively with a dedicated customer support platform such as Zendesk or Salesforce. However, I understand that CRM and ticketing systems are used to record interactions, assign requests, manage statuses, escalation and follow-up. I have strong experience with digital tools, documentation and managing issues to completion, so I am confident that I can learn the company’s system quickly.
entries.firstSentence: I have not yet worked extensively with a dedicated customer support platform such as Zendesk or Salesforce.

entries.question: How do you organise several open customer cases?
aliases: How do you manage multiple tickets?
Jak organizuje Pan wiele otwartych spraw?
entries.answer: I classify cases by urgency, customer impact, deadlines and dependency on other teams. I record a clear next action and review waiting cases so they are not forgotten. I also separate quick tasks from cases that need investigation, while keeping customers updated when a solution will take longer.
entries.firstSentence: I classify cases by urgency, customer impact, deadlines and dependency on other teams.

entries.question: How do you prioritise phone, email and chat requests?
aliases: How do you manage several support channels?
Jak ustala Pan priorytety między telefonem, e-mailem i czatem?
entries.answer: I would follow the company’s service levels and consider urgency and risk rather than simply choosing the oldest channel. Live calls and chats need immediate acknowledgement, while emails can be organised by deadline and impact. If a financial or safety-related case appeared, I would prioritise or escalate it according to procedure while making sure other customers still received an update.
entries.firstSentence: I would follow the company’s service levels and consider urgency and risk rather than simply choosing the oldest channel.

entries.question: What would you do if you made an error in a customer record?
aliases: How do you handle a documentation mistake?
Co Pan zrobi, jeśli popełni błąd w dokumentacji?
entries.answer: I would correct the record according to the system procedure, keep the audit history intact and inform a supervisor if the error could affect the customer or another team. I would not hide the mistake. I would also check whether any follow-up message or action needed correction and learn how to prevent the same error.
entries.firstSentence: I would correct the record according to the system procedure, keep the audit history intact and inform a supervisor if the error could affect the customer or another team.

entries.question: Are you comfortable working remotely?
aliases: Do you have experience with remote work?
Czy odpowiada Panu praca zdalna?
entries.answer: Yes, I am comfortable working remotely. I am used to working independently with digital communication tools and clear written documentation. I currently have a quiet place to work and reliable internet. When relocating to Serbia, I would make sure that I had the same stable working conditions before starting remote work.
entries.firstSentence: Yes, I am comfortable working remotely.

entries.question: How do you organise your working day at home?
aliases: How do you stay productive remotely?
Jak organizuje Pan dzień pracy zdalnej?
entries.answer: I start by reviewing priorities, scheduled commitments and open follow-ups. I keep my workspace free from distractions, update records as I work and use clear task lists rather than relying on memory. I also communicate early when I need information from another person so that remote work does not create unnecessary delays.
entries.firstSentence: I start by reviewing priorities, scheduled commitments and open follow-ups.

entries.question: How do you stay focused while working remotely?
aliases: How do you avoid distractions at home?
Jak utrzymuje Pan koncentrację w domu?
entries.answer: I use a dedicated quiet workspace, keep a clear task list and work in focused blocks with planned breaks. During working hours I remove personal distractions and keep communication tools available. For customer support, I would also prepare the headset, connection and required systems before the shift begins.
entries.firstSentence: I use a dedicated quiet workspace, keep a clear task list and work in focused blocks with planned breaks.

entries.question: What would you do if your internet connection failed?
aliases: How would you handle a remote-work connection problem?
Co Pan zrobi w razie awarii internetu?
entries.answer: I would immediately inform the responsible supervisor through an available backup channel and follow the company’s continuity procedure. I would try the approved backup connection if available and document any customer work that needed reassignment. I understand that reliable internet is essential, so I will also choose accommodation in Serbia with stable service.
entries.firstSentence: I would immediately inform the responsible supervisor through an available backup channel and follow the company’s continuity procedure.
groundingFacts: Reliable internet is a housing requirement

entries.question: How do you work with international teams?
aliases: Are you comfortable in a multicultural team?
Jak pracuje Pan w międzynarodowym zespole?
entries.answer: I focus on clear communication, respectful language and written confirmation of important decisions. I have lived and worked in Poland since 2021, use Polish daily and cooperate with people from different professional backgrounds. When something is unclear, I ask a direct question instead of relying on cultural assumptions.
entries.firstSentence: I focus on clear communication, respectful language and written confirmation of important decisions.

entries.question: Tell me about a time you received critical feedback.
aliases: How do you respond to feedback?
Jak reaguje Pan na krytyczną informację zwrotną?
entries.answer: I try to separate the useful information from the emotion of the moment. I ask for a specific example, confirm what result is expected and then change the process or work product. In technical projects, feedback is essential because testing and user comments often reveal something that was not visible during development.
entries.firstSentence: I try to separate the useful information from the emotion of the moment.

entries.question: Tell me about a mistake you made.
aliases: How do you handle your mistakes?
Proszę opowiedzieć o popełnionym błędzie.
entries.answer: When I make a mistake, I first correct the immediate effect and communicate it honestly to the people concerned. Then I identify why it happened and add a practical prevention step, such as a checklist, clearer documentation or another verification. I believe responsibility means not only admitting a mistake, but reducing the chance that it happens again.
entries.firstSentence: When I make a mistake, I first correct the immediate effect and communicate it honestly to the people concerned.

entries.question: How do you deal with stress?
aliases: How do you work under pressure?
Jak radzi Pan sobie ze stresem?
entries.answer: I focus on facts, priorities and the next controllable action. I avoid reacting emotionally, especially when another person is upset. In technical, business and legal work I learned that a calm structure—understand the issue, decide what is urgent, act and communicate—usually reduces pressure for everyone.
entries.firstSentence: I focus on facts, priorities and the next controllable action.

entries.question: How do you handle conflict with a colleague?
aliases: What would you do if you disagreed with a teammate?
Jak rozwiązuje Pan konflikt z kolegą?
entries.answer: I would discuss the specific facts and desired result rather than judging the person. I would listen to the colleague’s reasoning, explain my concern and look for a solution consistent with company procedure and customer needs. If we could not resolve an important issue, I would involve the appropriate manager without turning it into a personal conflict.
entries.firstSentence: I would discuss the specific facts and desired result rather than judging the person.

entries.question: How do you respond to changing procedures?
aliases: Are you adaptable?
Jak reaguje Pan na zmiany procedur?
entries.answer: I first make sure I understand what changed, why it changed and from which date it applies. Then I update my notes and follow the new process consistently. My career has included legal, business, technical and creative roles, so learning new requirements and adapting to different environments is familiar to me.
entries.firstSentence: I first make sure I understand what changed, why it changed and from which date it applies.

entries.question: How quickly do you learn new systems?
aliases: How would you learn our tools?
Jak szybko uczy się Pan nowych systemów?
entries.answer: I learn best by understanding the workflow, practising common tasks and checking my results against the correct procedure. My software work requires me to learn new tools regularly, and my previous businesses required practical learning in different technical areas. I would use training materials, take structured notes and ask focused questions when necessary.
entries.firstSentence: I learn best by understanding the workflow, practising common tasks and checking my results against the correct procedure.

entries.question: Are you ready to work rotating shifts?
aliases: Can you work different shifts?
Czy jest Pan gotowy do pracy zmianowej?
entries.answer: Yes, I am ready to work rotating shifts. I understand that customer support requires flexibility, especially when customers and team members may work at different times. I would organise my routine and workspace around the published schedule so that I could be reliable for each shift.
entries.firstSentence: Yes, I am ready to work rotating shifts.

entries.question: Why are you considering relocation to Serbia?
aliases: Why Serbia?
Dlaczego rozważa Pan przeprowadzkę do Serbii?
entries.answer: I am considering Serbia because it offers a realistic opportunity to continue my professional development in an international environment. I am interested in building stable long-term experience, using Polish professionally and developing further in customer support. I am currently based in Poland, so I would discuss the required employment, residence and relocation steps openly and agree on a realistic timeline before making firm commitments.
entries.firstSentence: I am considering Serbia because it offers a realistic opportunity to continue my professional development in an international environment.

entries.question: When could you relocate and start work?
aliases: What is your availability?
How soon can you move?
Kiedy może Pan rozpocząć pracę i przeprowadzić się?
entries.answer: I could normally start within one month. If the company needs me earlier, I will make every effort to be available within two or three weeks, although I do not want to promise a date before the practical arrangements are confirmed. I expect relocation to take about one to one and a half months, possibly earlier depending on administrative circumstances.
entries.firstSentence: I could normally start within one month.
keywords: two to three weeks if possible

entries.question: Are you legally able to work in Serbia?
aliases: Do you already have a Serbian work permit?
What is your work authorisation status?
Czy ma Pan prawo do pracy w Serbii?
entries.answer: I do not currently claim an existing unrestricted right to work in Serbia. I understand the general residence and employment procedure, and my preferred option would be to obtain temporary residence based on employment. I am ready to provide the required documents and cooperate with the employer on the formalities.
entries.firstSentence: I do not currently claim an existing unrestricted right to work in Serbia.
groundingFacts: No current unrestricted work right claimed

entries.question: What are your salary expectations?
aliases: Is the advertised salary acceptable?
Jakie są Pana oczekiwania finansowe?
entries.answer: The advertised salary of one thousand two hundred and sixty euros gross per month, together with the stated benefits and possible performance bonus, is acceptable to me at the initial stage. My immediate priorities are to join an international company, gain direct customer support experience and establish myself professionally in Serbia.
entries.firstSentence: The advertised salary of one thousand two hundred and sixty euros gross per month, together with the stated benefits and possible performance bonus, is acceptable to me at the initial stage.

entries.question: Do you have direct experience communicating with clients?
aliases: Tell me about your customer contact experience.
Czy ma Pan doświadczenie w kontakcie z klientami?
entries.answer: Yes, I have direct experience communicating with clients. I worked with clients as a lawyer and while managing my advertising and ventilation businesses. I listened to their needs, explained services and options, discussed practical conditions and followed the work until completion. This experience taught me to communicate clearly and take responsibility for follow-up.
entries.firstSentence: Yes, I have direct experience communicating with clients.

entries.question: Do you have sales experience?
aliases: Tell me about your experience in sales.
Czy ma Pan doświadczenie w sprzedaży?
entries.answer: Yes, I have practical sales experience from running my own businesses. I communicated directly with customers, identified their needs, explained available services, discussed price and conditions and helped them choose an appropriate solution. My approach was consultative rather than aggressive: first understand the need, then offer a suitable option and explain it clearly.
entries.firstSentence: Yes, I have practical sales experience from running my own businesses.

entries.question: Do you have experience processing orders?
aliases: Have you handled customer orders?
Czy ma Pan doświadczenie w obsłudze zamówień?
entries.answer: I have experience processing and coordinating service orders rather than retail product orders. In my advertising and ventilation businesses, I received requests, clarified requirements, discussed scope, price and timeline, organised the work and supported the customer until completion. I understand that retail order processing also requires accuracy, clear communication, documentation and follow-up.
entries.firstSentence: I have experience processing and coordinating service orders rather than retail product orders.
groundingFacts: No confirmed retail product order experience

entries.question: What did you do between 2008 and 2015?
aliases: Can you explain this period in your career?
Czym zajmował się Pan w latach 2008–2015?
entries.answer: Between 2008 and 2015, I worked in several technical, operational and creative roles. My experience included working with television broadcast equipment as a broadcast video engineer, composing music for television, ventilation installation and security work. It was a varied period that strengthened my responsibility, adaptability and practical problem-solving skills.
entries.firstSentence: Between 2008 and 2015, I worked in several technical, operational and creative roles.

entries.question: What did you do as a broadcast video engineer?
aliases: Tell me about your television technical work.
Na czym polegała Pana praca jako inżyniera wideo?
entries.answer: I worked with television broadcast equipment as a broadcast video engineer. The role was connected with the technical operation of broadcasting equipment and required concentration, responsibility and a calm response when a technical issue had to be handled quickly. I would keep the description at this level unless the interviewer asks about a specific system or task.
entries.firstSentence: I worked with television broadcast equipment as a broadcast video engineer.

entries.question: What have you been doing since 2021?
aliases: Tell me about your time in Poland.
Czym zajmuje się Pan od 2021 roku?
entries.answer: I have been living in Poland since 2021. From 2021 to 2023, I studied at a Polish post-secondary vocational school and qualified as an Administration Technician. I also continued developing technical and software skills, started independent mobile and backend projects and now use Polish in daily and professional communication.
entries.firstSentence: I have been living in Poland since 2021.

entries.question: How would you describe your English level?
aliases: Are you comfortable working in English?
Jaki jest Pana poziom angielskiego?
entries.answer: My English is at an intermediate level. I can communicate in writing and in conversations, understand professional information and cooperate with an international team. I am continuing to improve my spoken English, and I focus on communicating clearly and accurately rather than using unnecessarily complicated language.
entries.firstSentence: My English is at an intermediate level.

entries.question: How often do you use Polish?
aliases: In what situations do you use Polish?
Jak często używa Pan języka polskiego?
entries.answer: I have lived in Poland since 2021 and use Polish every day in practical and professional situations. I completed a Polish post-secondary vocational programme in administration and cooperate with Polish-speaking users and colleagues. I am comfortable explaining issues, discussing work and handling normal professional communication in Polish.
entries.firstSentence: I have lived in Poland since 2021 and use Polish every day in practical and professional situations.

entries.question: Are you comfortable speaking with Polish customers by phone?
aliases: Can you provide telephone support in Polish?
Czy może Pan obsługiwać klientów telefonicznie po polsku?
entries.answer: Yes, I am comfortable speaking with Polish customers by phone. I use Polish every day and I am ready to communicate with customers in live conversations. On a call, I would listen carefully, confirm important names or numbers and summarise the next step before ending the conversation. If a specific term was unclear, I would ask politely for clarification rather than guess.
entries.firstSentence: Yes, I am comfortable speaking with Polish customers by phone.

entries.question: What would you do if you did not understand the interviewer or customer?
aliases: What if you do not understand an accent?
Co Pan zrobi, jeśli nie zrozumie rozmówcy?
entries.answer: I would ask politely for the person to repeat or rephrase the point and then confirm my understanding. For important details such as a name, order number or date, I would repeat them back. It is better to clarify one sentence than to continue with an incorrect assumption.
entries.firstSentence: I would ask politely for the person to repeat or rephrase the point and then confirm my understanding.

entries.question: Do you have any questions for us?
aliases: What would you like to ask us?
Czy ma Pan pytania do nas?
entries.answer: Yes, I would like to ask about the training, systems and usual shift pattern. How is the initial training organised, and which CRM or ticketing system does the team use? I would also like to know how performance is measured during the first months and how the company supports the employment and relocation process for a candidate moving to Serbia.
entries.firstSentence: Yes, I would like to ask about the training, systems and usual shift pattern.
